BILLSessionCredential.title: BILL AP/AR Session
BILLSessionCredential.x-credential-instructions: Paste your BILL AP/AR developer key and its matching session ID from POST /v3/login. Sessions expire after 35 minutes of inactivity; replace the session ID when it expires. Scheduling payments requires an MFA-trusted session. Spend & Expense API tokens do not work for AP/AR. Select the environment where the session was created.
